jobs.title: Find a job
jobs.text: The «Jobs» tab shows all vacancies. Filter by area, salary and schedule, and apply in one tap.

workers.title: Find workers
workers.text: The «Candidates» tab shows ready candidates, with what makes each one fit your vacancy.

post.title: AI writes your job post
post.text: The «Post» tab — describe it in your own words. AI organizes it into sections and creates polished text and a promo image.

chat.title: Chat and notifications
chat.text: Applications, offers and replies are in «Chat» and 🔔. Important messages also arrive on Telegram.

quick.title: What would you like to do?

cross.worker_desc: You can post a vacancy too — AI will write it in 1 minute
cross.employer_desc: One account lets you search for both jobs and workers

help.title: Help
help.subtitle: How to use the app — short and simple.
help.worker_1: On the home screen tap “Browse open jobs”.
help.worker_2: Type your profession in search or pick an area and filters.
help.worker_3: Open a job and tap “Apply” — when you see “Application sent”, it arrived.
help.worker_4: Use “Create a job-seeker listing” to say what you can do — employers will find you.
help.worker_5: Replies and invitations appear in “My applications” and 🔔 notifications.
help.employer_1: On the home screen tap the big “+ Post a job” button.
help.employer_2: Choose who you need (sector → profession), then set conditions step by step.
help.employer_3: Review the finished listing and tap “Publish”.
help.employer_4: Right after publishing we show matching candidates; you can also search in “Candidates”.
help.employer_5: See applications under “Jobs posted”, reply or invite to an interview.
help.safety_1: Never send money to anyone to get a job.
help.safety_2: Your phone number is visible only to employers you allow.
help.safety_3: See a suspicious listing or message? Tap “Report”.
help.report_hint: Every job and profile page has a “Report” button.

worker-jobs.title: Job openings
